line: # HCURS: cursive H, two uprights and crossbar
# KR: small R/k with diagonal leg
# HLOOP: H made of a left loop joined to a tall upright
# ARROWCIRC: circle with rising arrow (mars sign)
# GLOOP: tall figure-8 / g with loops
# SQ: open square with top bar
# TBASE: plus sign standing on a horizontal base bar
# DCROSS: vertical with two crossbars (double dagger)
# LCURL: pound-sign-like curl with crossbar and base
# CROSSBOX: cross on top of an open box
# CURLE: open curl with descending loop
# XI: crossed gamma/xi curl with loop at foot
# ZLOOP: z with loop at upper left
# EPS: open e / epsilon (or rho) with tail
# BOXSTEM: small box pierced by a vertical stem
# TOWER: open box under a horizontal lid bar
# LIBRA: omega arch over two bars (libra-like)
# ATAIL: a/9 with long horizontal tail
# IIBAR: II between top and bottom bars
